purpose: Provide source-backed candidate evidence for reviewing Inventory/Ontology/Context Builder boundaries and EvidenceSet pressure.
non_authority_notice: This packet is an Inventory handoff example. It does not promote ontology relations, premises, meanings, confidence, or governed definitions. Ontology Vault must review and accept any downstream relation or premise separately.

candidate_cards.handoff_reason: Defines Inventory as evidence substrate for ontology boundary review.
Defines ontology as thick agent-usable knowledge for contrast with Inventory evidence.
Protects against treating ontology as a dump of Inventory records.
States that promotion belongs to owning capabilities.

requested_review: Decide whether these boundary claims should become ontology candidates, premises, or remain Inventory-only evidence.
Review whether the candidate relation labels are acceptable or need Ontology Vault vocabulary changes.
Confirm that no card in this packet implies downstream promotion.
residue: EvidenceSet may become useful if the same boundary group is repeatedly handed off to Ontology Vault and Context Builder.
